name: petdeface
summary: Defaces a PET image and its T1-weighted anatomical image with petdeface, a Nipype pipeline that co-registers the two and applies FreeSurfer MiDeFace.
description: Wraps the openneuropet petdeface tool, which builds a temporary BIDS dataset from the PET and T1w files, co-registers them and removes facial features from both. Use it to anonymise PET data before sharing. Requires a FreeSurfer license. The current main script expects --t1_file and --pet_file command-line arguments for the inputs, so the App may not run as registered.

inputs.requirements: Needs a JSON sidecar; subject IDs in the PET and T1w file names must match when present.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image of the same subject, used for registration and defacing.

outputs.description: this is where we collect the defaced images, registration files, and defacing masks

parameters.description: Number of processors passed to petdeface (--n_procs).
Where petdeface writes defaced images (--placement): adjacent, inplace or derivatives.

failure_modes.message: FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable not set, exiting.

failure_modes.cause: PET and T1w file names carry different BIDS subject IDs.
failure_modes.fix: Use PET and T1w images from the same subject.
